description: A single-storey booth on a concrete plinth, raised about four feet so the window is at cab height, with a canopy running out from it over the plates. Grey plate, no windows on three sides, and on the fourth a long sheet of glass with the board's repeater inside it and somebody behind that. A steel stair goes up the side to a door nobody uses from the road.
name: The Glacis Weigh — Booth
